findings.userImpact: A reference from another platform can lead to inappropriate navigation, controls, or layout for the intended platform.
findings.recommendation: Use an approved reference for the intended platform or record an explicit rationale for the divergence.

findings.userImpact: A local component override can drift from canonical design-system styling and make later updates inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each override is intentional; use the canonical component property or variant when it is not.

findings.userImpact: Unbound or mismatched typography may become inconsistent and fail to track approved type-system changes.
findings.recommendation: Restore the approved text-style binding if the detachment was not intentional.

findings.userImpact: Content exceeds the recorded available region; users may lose access to text or controls in this long-content case.
findings.recommendation: Provide sufficient layout growth or an intentional scroll path so the complete content and related actions remain reachable.

findings.userImpact: The recorded contrast ratio is below the supplied requirement, which can make this text difficult to perceive.
findings.recommendation: Choose colors that meet the applicable contrast requirement while preserving the intended visual hierarchy.
